transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a critical constraint before you authorize this run. I received a customer deviation email on Thursday that limits this pilot run to exactly 480 units — not up to 900 — and requires 100% torque verification performed by one IPC-certified inspector and one independent verifier. This deviation has not yet been attached to the production order, so the provisional run of up to 900 units currently on the board does not reflect these requirements.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Elena, from a shift supervision perspective, I can confirm the roster situation for Sunday. My Friday check with HR confirmed that only three people are cleared and available for the 06:00-14:00 shift: Nia, who is our IPC-certified inspector; Omar, our independent verifier; and Luis, our qualified assembly operator. The roster update has not yet been entered on the production board, so the board may not reflect this yet. The good news is that this roster satisfies Ravi's deviation requirement of one IPC-certified inspector and one independent verifier for the 100% torque verification.
